answers.core: I feel this is a common use case with a pretty wide range of applicability that it should be a core feature. It could be used for lots of different types of bullet spread in shooters, explosions, or sight cones for NPCs in action/stealth/RPG games. If my PointShape node idea were implemented, it could have even wider applicability and make it easier to add stuff like missile-type projectile spread in platformers, top-down shooters and bullet hell games. It could also be used to easily make projectile-based explosions, and it may serve as a good visual way to control particle effects.
answers.workaround: Not really, not if you have the different use cases I do where I've ended up with different solutions in different areas. This node could handle random weapon spread too, but I've had to use a different approach again to that. That's three different solutions that might all be handleable with just this one node.
